confirm.what: The pulled item stats: weight, footprint, stack size, bag grids and unlock levels
confirm.why: data/armory-stats.json was read out of the MetaForge database on 2026-08-31, the same source the prices were typed from, and every price in the pull matched the catalogue, which is how the join was checked. It is still a transcription and not a measurement. The ones worth checking first are the ones the loadout page leans on: the bag grids, since the Field Backpack comes out 3x3 where one fan site says 6x2, and the stack sizes, since a frag grenade is listed as not stacking at all. Since 2026-08-31 there is a way in: node tools/measure.js "Assault Backpack" storage 4x5 writes a measured figure that beats the pull, and node tools/measure.js --list storage says which bags and rigs are still unmeasured.

The last figure between the PKM and a full row on the damage page. Searched again on 2026-09-01 and it is published nowhere: MetaForge carries no fire rate for any weapon, wardogs.zone lists none, and the 28 rates the page does have were derived from a shots-and-time table that has no PKM row. So it has to be counted: fire ten seconds into a wall, count the rounds, then node tools/measure.js "PKM" rpm <number>. Until then the page says what it does know and says the clock is missing.
